an6.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an6.10:1.2: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.10:1.3: yo so bhante ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatīti.
an6.10:2.1: yo so mahānāma ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharati
an6.10:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an6.10:2.4: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:2.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha
an6.10:2.6: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:2.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:2.9: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃ samāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:3.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati
an6.10:3.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
an6.10:3.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:3.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha
an6.10:3.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:3.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:3.8: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhammānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:4.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako saṃghaṃ anussarati
an6.10:4.2: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti
an6.10:4.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako saṃghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṃghaṃ ārabbha
an6.10:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:4.8: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāyapajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃṃ samāpanno saṃghānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:5.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññūpasaṭṭhāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni
an6.10:5.2: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:5.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha
an6.10:5.4: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:5.5: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:5.7: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:6.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati
an6.10:6.2: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an6.10:6.3: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti
an6.10:6.4: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:6.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha
an6.10:6.6: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:6.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:6.9: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃ samāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:7.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako devatānussatiṃ bhāveti
an6.10:7.2: santi devā cātummahārājikā santi devā tāvatiṃsā santi devā yāmā santi devā tusitā santi devā nimmānaratino santi devā paranimmitavasavattino santi devā brahmakāyikā santi devā taduttari
an6.10:7.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā mayhaṃpi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati
an6.10:7.4: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā mayhaṃpi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati
an6.10:7.5: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā tato cutā tatthūpapannā mayhaṃpi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati
an6.10:7.6: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā mayhaṃpi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati
an6.10:7.7: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tatthūpapannā mayhaṃpi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti
an6.10:7.8: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an6.10:7.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha
an6.10:7.10: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an6.10:7.11: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an6.10:7.13: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:8.1: yo so mahānāma ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharatīti.
